name: Therapiefinder
tagline: support in search of a therapy
blurb: Therapiefinder supports you in your search for a psychotherapy appointment in Germany.
description:
Therapiefinder supports you in your search for a psychotherapy appointment in Germany.
The app lets you maintain a list of psychotherapy practices and reminds you to call them during their opening hours. You can log contacts in the app and then export the log for reimbursement purposes.
Thus far the app is only available in german.
